The [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] had a '''safe house''' in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. They used this is as their base of operations during their time in the city, returning to it after skirmishes.
